patterns.note: A flexible, masonry-like grid of image cards with varying aspect ratios is used to display portfolio items, maintaining consistent horizontal and vertical spacing between them.

The hero section features a large, multi-weight text statement where the primary descriptive phrase is bold and dark, while the secondary, more detailed information is lighter in weight and color, creating a subtle visual hierarchy.
The site employs a predominantly monochromatic palette of white, black, and various grays, allowing the vibrant colors of the portfolio imagery to stand out as the main visual interest.
The main navigation bar at the top and a video reel call-to-action button at the bottom-right remain sticky to the viewport as the user scrolls, while all other content scrolls normally.
Client logos are presented as a horizontal strip of grayscale icons, implying a scrollable or carousel-like display for social proof.

technique_notes: A fixed header bar is used at the top of the viewport, ensuring navigation links are always accessible. Similarly, a floating, fixed-position call-to-action button is anchored to the bottom-right of the viewport, persisting across scroll depths.
Content is organized into a dynamic grid system where image cards of different dimensions are arranged to fill available space, creating a visually engaging and non-uniform layout.
The hero text block uses distinct font weights and color opacity to differentiate between a primary statement and its supporting details, guiding the user's eye through the introduction.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold hero text (~3-4x body) with a lighter, slightly faded secondary line, contrasted with small, light gray captions.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on image cards and the sticky video button.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy overall, with generous vertical spacing in the hero and between major sections, and balanced horizontal spacing within the image grid.

standout: This site stands out with its art-gallery-like presentation of work, using a flexible, image-first grid that feels both curated and expansive. The distinctive hero text, combining bold and faded elements, immediately establishes a sophisticated tone, while the persistent sticky video reel button offers a subtle, ever-present call to action without cluttering the minimal aesthetic.
